title: ACad Circuit CAD Tool
description: A lightweight C++ circuit schematic viewer and editor for placing and connecting resistors, capacitors, coils, transistors, and wires. Includes grid snapping and JSON save/load for reusable circuit layouts.

title: Bluetooth LED Controller
description: An ATmega328P-based Bluetooth circuit using an HM-10 module, ST7735 display, and LED outputs, paired with a Flutter controller application that sends commands over Bluetooth.

title: Claw Machine V1
description: A custom ATmega328 microcontroller board for a claw machine project, combining embedded control code with schematic, board design, and technical documentation.

title: QuestGame PIC32 USB and C
description: A PIC32 USB CDC quiz-game system with a GTK C host controller, I2C LCD backpacks, physical player buttons, and active-low LED game-state indicators.

title: MathGen
description: An AI-driven math study aid that uses the OpenAI API to generate practice problems by subject and subtopic, with a Flutter interface and Node.js backend.

title: Family Calendar .NET
description: A family chore and rewards application where parents manage assignments and incentives while children submit completion proof and earn stars for the reward shop.

title: Vigo's Rock Paper Scissors
description: A multiplayer Rock Paper Scissors game with timed hands and group results, built to explore reactive programming with Node.js and Socket.IO.

title: VigoChat
description: A multi-user chat application with public rooms and private messaging, built with jQuery, Node.js, and Socket.IO.

title: Interactive Slide Puzzle
description: A draggable numbered tile puzzle written in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, featuring animations, audio, and a lightweight game loop.

title: Jobify MERN
description: A full-stack job tracking application built while completing a MERN course, using MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js.
